notes: batch-0367-review-fix (2026-11-13, parent batch-0367=1915547e3ec). Review found the run-level greedy budget redistribution produced: B1 27 comment frame breaks (zh text placed at column 0), B2 6 broken sentences/lost content, B3 4 cross-line word duplicates, B4 2 ASCII identifier splits. These are too pervasive for surgical fix — redistributor fundamentally violates comment frame integrity by moving text across prefix boundaries. Reverted miscinit.c to EN baseline. miscinit will be re-translated in a future batch using strict per-line budget discipline (no cross-line text movement). globals.c and usercontext.c (batch-0366) are unaffected and remain translated. Gates: verify_c_comments 0 violations after revert.
